content.content: This layer reads the working-copy changed-path set via `jj diff --summary` for recording's attribution. Paths only — no content reads at this boundary.
content.rationale: Recording places each edit in its owning change, which needs the changed set first. `jj status` carries no template, so `jj diff --summary` names the changed paths in a machine-readable form — as wide as attribution and no wider.
